name: clustering_coefficient
author: da50612d
description: Local clustering coefficient: how tightly knit a node's neighbourhood is, i.e. the fraction of pairs of its neighbours that are themselves linked (0 = no triangles, 1 = all neighbours know each other). Use for questions like 'how tightly knit is Alice's circle?', 'do X's friends know each other?', 'how clustered is this network?', 'which nodes sit in the densest groups?'. Give 'node' (an id from lookup_node) to get that node's coefficient, degree and triangle count plus the graph average; omit it to get the graph's average clustering and the top_k most clustered nodes. Works on undirected and directed graphs (directed uses Fagiolo's directed-triangle definition, as NetworkX does). Edge weights are ignored unless weighted=true (geometric mean of max-normalised weights).

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

node.description: Optional node id (from lookup_node). If given, returns that node's clustering coefficient; if omitted, returns the graph average and the top_k nodes.

top_k.description: How many of the most clustered nodes to return when no node is given.

weighted.description: Use edge weights (weighted clustering, NetworkX definition). Default false: count triangles only.
